label: Enable Arc Converter
description: Master switch for automatic item processing.

label: Weapons
description: Automatically process only newly acquired weapons at the selected tiers. Existing weapons are not scanned.

label: Weapon action
description: Choose whether eligible newly acquired weapons are sold for eddies or disassembled into components.

label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 1 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 2 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 2 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 3 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 3 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 4 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 4 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 5 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 5 weapons acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Clothes
description: Automatically process only newly acquired clothing at selected tiers. Existing clothing is not scanned.

label: Clothes action
description: Choose whether eligible newly acquired clothes are sold for eddies or disassembled into components.

label: Tier 1 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 1 clothes acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 2 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 2 clothes acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 3 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 3 clothes acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 4 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 4 clothes acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Tier 5 (+ variants)
description: Process eligible Tier 5 clothes acquired after enabling the mod.

label: Automatically craft ammunition
description: Use vanilla crafting and components to replenish ammunition for the currently equipped weapon.

label: Craft when reserve below (%)
description: Craft one vanilla recipe batch when ammunition falls below this percentage of its capacity. Never exceed the game's ammo limit.

label: Automatically sell junk for eddies
description: Sell ordinary junk and jewelry anywhere, using normal game selling prices. Includes junk already in the backpack. Quest and protected items are skipped.
